user_query: I'm organizing a roast party and I need some insults for different categories like fat jokes and yo mama jokes. Can you provide me with all the available joke categories and fetch jokes for the selected categories? Moreover, I want to include some dad jokes to balance the humor.

TaskList.description: Select desired joke categories (e.g., fat jokes, yo mama jokes, dad jokes). This step requires the user to decide based on available categories from Step 1.
Fetch jokes from the selected categories.
